decisions.decision: Use a unified three-column calculator: work categories, selectable price rows with quantities, and a visual total summary.
decisions.reason: Matches the approved detailing reference while preserving SIRIUS data and dark gold identity.

decisions.decision: Highlight selected and hovered plates with a left-to-right fading gold wash and a visible gold edge.
decisions.reason: Carries the detailing interaction motif into service cards, hero badges, and calculator rows.

decisions.decision: Open the price route with the full price list, place the calculator after it, and render the calculator as a compact dark layout without a containing background panel.
decisions.reason: Final user-selected revision: transparent outer container, dark controls, reduced calculator height.

decisions.decision: Remove service and booking lead paragraphs, keep all price accordions closed initially, and reduce the hero cashback badge to compact CTA scale.
decisions.reason: User requested faster access to the booking form and less introductory content.

decisions.decision: Make the pothole repair and asphalt crumb cards fully clickable 3D flip cards with opaque dark mini price tables and gold headers.
decisions.reason: Matches the supplied work-order tables and the established full price-list styling.

decisions.decision: Use a compact 2×2 service grid; show package price in its own full-width gold strip and keep the flip-side body as a clean numbered work list without units.
decisions.reason: Separating price from work names prevents column overlap and keeps every compact card readable.

decisions.decision: Replace the cashback plate with three border-only guarantee, budget, and compliance benefits.
decisions.reason: Keeps the hero focused on the company's main customer promises without another heavy card surface.

decisions.decision: Align the 'Как проходит работа' heading over the left process column and the smaller 'Оставить заявку' heading directly over the right form column; use the same heading scale for the contacts page, exactly eight price-list choices, and no referral field.
decisions.reason: The paired headings establish a clear two-column entry point while keeping the form clear of navigation and visually connected to its title.

decisions.decision: Remove the contact-page lead, use a compact title, lift contact details and map directly beneath it, and render all contact values in high-contrast text.
decisions.reason: The complete contact block and map should read as one screen, matching the compact booking-page composition.

decisions.decision: Keep ДОРОГА gold while settled, but use the exact Dia Text reference palette (#c679c4, #fa3d1d, #ffb005, #e1e1fe, #0358f7) in the forward and reverse sweep.
decisions.reason: Matches the supplied reference colors without losing the approved gold resting state or lightweight reverse animation.

decisions.decision: Render all four white hero lines as stable text without a hover dispersion effect.
decisions.reason: Final user revision removes the character breakup animation entirely.

decisions.decision: Use the supplied transparent animated logo at 190–240px on desktop and 176px on mobile, muted and looped; keep the original image for reduced motion and fallback.
decisions.reason: Uses the supplied brand motion without green spill, audio, layout shift, or forced animation for motion-sensitive visitors.

decisions.decision: Use three concise benefit statements with a bold lead claim followed by a regular-weight supporting sentence.
decisions.reason: Creates clear scan hierarchy while preserving the exact customer-facing copy selected by the user.

decisions.decision: Unify the full-price, calculator, and terms heading scale; use the body typeface for all prices and row numbers; keep the desktop estimate column at the same fixed visual height as the work list.
decisions.reason: Makes pricing easier to scan and keeps the image, total, and estimate CTA stable while the work list scrolls independently.

decisions.decision: Use the supplied VIDEO HERO SIRIUS MP4 byte-for-byte as the hero background, with a lighter layered scrim and a paused first frame for reduced-motion visitors.
decisions.reason: Preserves the exact source quality while revealing more image detail without sacrificing text readability or motion accessibility.

decisions.decision: Make repeated activation of the home link scroll to the hero, use the same scene and text treatment for home and routed services, and let service price cards toggle from either face without a close icon.
decisions.reason: Removes route-state dead ends and keeps scrolling, direct navigation, mouse, keyboard, and touch interactions consistent.

decisions.decision: Lift case carousels and the full price list, enlarge gold case locations, remove the gray cases lead, and bottom-align the contacts CTA with the map.
decisions.reason: Tightens page entry points and creates clearer vertical alignment across cases, pricing, and contacts.

decisions.decision: Increase the animated logo within taller desktop and mobile header bounds, nudge it down on compact screens, and place a calculator CTA beside the hero benefits with a direct price-calculator anchor.
decisions.reason: Keeps the logo prominent without crossing the header divider and gives visitors a direct estimation path from the first screen.

decisions.decision: Use the supplied road image as a dark 16:9 full-price background and crossfade to the supplied paving-machine image when the calculator reaches the viewport.
decisions.reason: Preserves text contrast while making the price-list and calculator portions visually distinct.
